chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: in a word = 用一句话概括,引出总结。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,这次旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: go to work
chunks.note: go to work (on sth) = 着手做某事;不只是'去上班'义。
chunks.ex_en: She went to work on the puzzle right away.
chunks.ex_cn: 她立刻着手解那道谜题。

chunks.head: at last
chunks.note: at last = 经过等待后终于。
chunks.ex_en: At last the bus arrived.

chunks.head: inch by inch
chunks.note: X by X = 逐X地;inch by inch 极言缓慢。
chunks.ex_en: The turtle crawled forward inch by inch.

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 很多。
chunks.ex_en: He spent a great deal of money on books.

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在两件事之间的这段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is at seven; in the meantime, let's play a game.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭七点开;在这之前我们先玩个游戏。

chunks.head: for the sake of
chunks.note: for the sake of sth/sb = 为了某事/某人。
chunks.ex_en: She learned to cook for the sake of her family.

chunks.head: what's the matter
chunks.note: what's the matter (with …)? = 关心地问出了什么问题。
chunks.ex_en: You look pale—what's the matter?

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.note: stand by sb = 在困难时支持、不离弃某人。
chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand by you in hard times.
chunks.ex_cn: 真朋友会在困境中支持你。

chunks.head: not a moment to lose
chunks.gloss: 一刻也不能耽误,刻不容缓
chunks.note: (have) not a moment to lose = 时间紧迫,一点也不能浪费。
chunks.ex_en: The train leaves soon—there's not a moment to lose!
chunks.ex_cn: 火车快开了——一刻也不能耽误!

chunks.head: take up
chunks.note: take up = 把某物拿到手里。

literal.note_cn: 此处表'拿起'的动作完成

chunks.ex_en: He took up his pen and began to write.

chunks.head: fire at
chunks.note: fire at sb/sth = 朝目标开枪、射击。
chunks.ex_en: The soldiers fired at the target.

chunks.head: pull out
chunks.note: pull out = 把某物从里面拉出、掏出。
chunks.ex_en: She pulled out a coin from her pocket.
chunks.ex_cn: 她从口袋里掏出一枚硬币。

chunks.head: in one's debt
chunks.note: be in sb's debt = 因受恩惠而欠人情。

literal.note_cn: 此处'人情之债',非金钱债

chunks.ex_en: You saved my life—I'm in your debt.
chunks.ex_cn: 你救了我的命——我欠你一个人情。

chunks.head: no sooner … than
chunks.note: no sooner … than … = 一…就…;句首倒装(no sooner had he …)。原文用旧式 but,今用 than。
chunks.ex_en: No sooner had she sat down than the phone rang.

chunks.head: with all one's might
chunks.note: with all one's might = 使出全部力气。

literal.note_cn: 此处作名词'力量',非'可能'

chunks.ex_en: He pushed the door with all his might.

chunks.head: put an end to
chunks.note: put an end to sth = 使某事停止、了结。
chunks.ex_en: The new rule put an end to the noise.

chunks.head: out of sight
chunks.note: out of sight = 超出可见范围。
chunks.ex_en: The ship sailed away until it was out of sight.

chunks.head: like the wind
chunks.note: run/go like the wind = 跑得飞快。
chunks.ex_en: The boy ran like the wind to catch the ball.

chunks.head: lay down one's life
chunks.note: lay down one's life (for …) = 为…舍生、捐躯。
chunks.ex_en: The heroes laid down their lives for their country.
